messages:
ashok: alert from backup telemetry: ~1.2k archived objects written without CMK tag after RBAC cleanup at 03:17 UTC. Anyone aware?
backup-bot: [automated] scan: 1,243 objects missing 'x-redwood-cmk' tag in prod-bucket-archive. Possible SSE fallback detected. :warning:
maria: Did we rename any roles during the RBAC sweep?
devon: yes, uploader-prod -> uploader-archive at 03:17 UTC. That probably changed the principal ARN used for KMS grants.
ashok: backup-agent flow: obtains an ephemeral KMS grant tied to role ARN. If grant lookup fails, agent falls back to SSE-S3.
sam: sample agent log from a failed encrypt:
```
2026-03-21T03:20:11Z backup-agent ERROR KMS Encrypt Failed: AccessDeniedException
principal arn:aws:iam::123456:role/uploader-archive
backup-agent: falling back to SSE-S3 for PutObject
```
maria: Are DB snapshots impacted or only S3 objects?
ashok: Query shows both. ~400 DB snapshot uploads logged Encrypt AccessDenied and ~1,243 S3 PutObject fallbacks. Ran quick audit query and exported keys.
devon: Quick mitigations: revert role rename (fast), create explicit KMS grant for new role ARN (fast), schedule re-encrypt/rewrite job for impacted objects (medium).
maria: Grant example (short-lived recommended):
aws kms create-grant --key-id alias/redwood-backups --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::123456:role/uploader-archive --operations Encrypt Decrypt --name "temp-grant-uploader-archive"
sam: Note: granting now won't retro-encrypt objects already written with SSE-S3. Those need rewrite. We'll canary a rewrite job.
backup-bot: created remediation ticket RED-ENC-452 and attached audit CSV.
devon: Plan: canary rewrite 10 objects with a streaming copy (read+put with SSE-KMS), verify checksums, then run fleet job with concurrency=50.
maria: Also add CI preflight for KMS grant presence on deploys and a metric alert for PutObject SSE-S3 responses above threshold.
ashok: starting canary for tenant=internal now; will post results. Tasks: devon create grant and document IAM playbook; ashok run canary; sam verify DB snapshot encryption + restore test; maria update runbook and own post-mortem.
oncall: acknowledged. Keep ops in the loop for customer-facing restores until we verify snapshot integrity.
maria: will update this thread with canary outcome and remediation status.
